bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt" || exit 71
test "$(stat -c %a "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt")" = 600 || exit 72
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugdual-0f3633f >/dev/null || exit 73
python3 -B - "$root" <<'PY'
import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);file=root/"deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
original=file.read_text()
if "GAYBBS_USERBOT_ACCOUNT_CHAT_ID_FILE" in original:
 print("COMPOSE_USERBOT_ALREADY_CONFIGURED")
else:
 changes=[
 ("      GAYBBS_USERBOT_REPORT_CHAT_ID_FILE: /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient",
  "      GAYBBS_USERBOT_REPORT_CHAT_ID_FILE: /run/secrets/bug_report_recipient\n      GAYBBS_USERBOT_ACCOUNT_CHAT_ID_FILE: /run/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account"),
 ("      - bug_report_recipient\n",
  "      - bug_report_recipient\n      - bug_report_userbot_account\n"),
 ("  bug_report_recipient:\n    file: ./secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt",
  "  bug_report_recipient:\n    file: ./secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt\n  bug_report_userbot_account:\n    file: ./secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt"),
 ]
 new=original
 for old,repl in changes:
  if new.count(old)!=1:sys.exit(80)
  new=new.replace(old,repl,1)
 backup=root/"deploy/.gserver-compose.bugdual-before-20261119.yaml"
 if backup.exists():sys.exit(81)
 backup.write_text(original)
 backup.chmod(0o600)
 tmp=file.with_name(file.name+".bugdual.tmp")
 if tmp.exists():sys.exit(82)
 tmp.write_text(new)
 tmp.chmod(file.stat().st_mode&0o777)
 os.replace(tmp,file)
 print("COMPOSE_USERBOT_SECRET_MOUNT_ADDED")
PY
(cd "$root/deploy" && docker compose -f gserver-compose.yaml config -q) || exit 83
echo COMPOSE_DUAL_DELIVERY_READY
